name: io.github.nurullahturkoglu.xapi.unity
description: An HttpMessageHandler that sends HttpClient requests with UnityWebRequest, so Xapi.Client works in WebGL players, and WebGLFileSystem.Persist, which saves Application.persistentDataPath to IndexedDB so a FileOutboxStore queue survives a page reload. Install Xapi.Client itself with NuGetForUnity.
